patient.name: Eleanor Prasad
problem_list: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (EF 30 percent)

clinical_notes: Readmission nine days after the previous heart failure discharge with recurrent volume overload. Weight on admission 75.8 kg against a documented dry weight of 71.4 kg. Diuresed with intravenous furosemide to a discharge weight of 71.9 kg. Sacubitril-valsartan uptitrated to 49/51 mg twice daily and low-dose spironolactone added; potassium 4.1 and creatinine 1.4 mg/dL at discharge, both stable. Basic metabolic panel required within 5 days given the new mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist and the increased diuretic dose.

Adherence review during this admission suggested the patient had been taking furosemide intermittently because she could not reliably remember the dose. A dosette box has been arranged. Home scales have now been provided.
nurse_handoff_notes: Patient remains short of breath on minimal exertion and continues to use a rolling walker. Still no caregiver at home and no transport arrangements in place. Daughter contacted by telephone and is aware of the readmission.
